messages:
anya_cs: Hi team — coordinating final steps for AuroraHealth dedicated pool bring-up. Need to lock quota and autoscale windows before the customer smoke tomorrow.

tom_eng: Thanks. Two quick asks: confirm initial reserved quota (they asked for 400 qps sustained) and whether we enable burst to 800 for 30m during ramp.

lia_sre: From infra side we can do 400 sustained with current pool shape. Burst to 800 is allowed if we enable temporary extra nodes and accept a warm-up penalty (~90s). We should schedule the burst window during low global traffic.

kevin_cust: Confirmed AuroraHealth expects a 30m ramp at 9:30am PT. They will point canary traffic at that time. Want autoscale triggers to be aggressive — fail open to the fallback model if capacity lags.

anya_cs: @kevin_cust noted. @tom_eng please propose autoscale policy and fallback. We'll need playbook entries for rollback and customer notification.

 tom_eng: Proposed policy:
- target CPU utilization 65% (steady)
- scale-up threshold: 3 consecutive 30s buckets above 70%
- max scale step: +40% nodes per step
- soft cap for burst: allow +100% nodes for 30m with manual approval
Fallback: route to smaller but compatible model variant (aurora-compact-v1) with rate-limited responses.

lia_sre: Sounds good. Couple of constraints:
- autoscale cooldown 2m to avoid flapping
- pre-warm KV cache on new nodes using prefix cache script
Command for pre-warm (run from ops machine):
```bash
./tools/prefix_prime.sh --project aurora --pool dedicated-aurora-01 --concurrency 32 --duration 15m
```

devops_bot: scheduled job created: prime-dedicated-aurora-2026-03-22T08:50Z

sophia_pm: @anya_cs can we add the smoke test checklist items? We need latency SLOs, error budget guardrails, and a customer-facing contact.

anya_cs: Adding checklist now:
- Quota: 400 sustained, burst to 800 for 30m at 2026-03-22 16:30 UTC
- Autoscale policy: as proposed by @tom_eng
- Pre-warm: run at 08:50Z, 15m prime
- Load tests: run internal shadow traffic at 16:00Z for 20m, then canary at 16:30Z
- Rollback: switch routing to aurora-compact-v1 + notify @kevin_cust
- Contacts: oncall SRE (lia_sre), Eng lead (tom_eng), CS (anya_cs)

kevin_cust: Will be on the call for canary and will hold on rollback decision. Also FYI they have a scheduled large batch job at 17:00 which we must avoid overlapping.

lia_sre: Good catch — we will keep a 30m buffer after the canary. Also will set a traffic cap to 50% of pool capacity if background batch starts.

tom_eng: Load test plan (internal shadow):
- tool: k6
- script: scripts/aurora_shadow.js
- target: 400 rps steady, 800 rps spike test at minute 10 for 3m
- metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost, error rate
k6 command:
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m scripts/aurora_shadow.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```

anya_cs: Can Ops schedule k6 and prime jobs? Lia will you confirm runbook steps and add to incident channel if anything spikes?

lia_sre: I'll run the prime job and monitor. I'll post in #incidents if p95 > 1.2s or error rate > 0.5% during the test.

sophia_pm: I'll send the customer invite for 16:15Z pre-check and 16:30Z canary. Also attaching the quickplay doc: https://redwood-internal/ops/playbooks/aurora-dedicated-bringup (watch only)

devops_bot: reminder: quota change request submitted to billing for 400 reserved units. Request ID: Q-98321

anya_cs: Final items: @tom_eng please prepare the fallback model image and ensure registry tag aurora-compact-v1:20260321 is available. @lia_sre prepare runbook snippet for automated reroute.

kevin_cust: Thanks all. We'll be on standby. If anything goes wrong, aim to rollback in under 10 minutes and notify the customer Slack channel.

anya_cs: Perfect — I'll update the onboarding tracker and post a short summary to the account health doc after the test. :thumbsup:
